news.headline: Bagheera the Giant Squash Breaks a World Record
news.body: A giant squash named Bagheera has been crowned the heaviest in the world by Guinness World Records. It weighed about 2,857 pounds (1,295.8 kg) — more than a white rhino! Its grower in England spent up to six hours a day caring for it, and it drank nearly 160 gallons of water a day during the hot summer.

news.headline: 180,000 Giant Tortoises Counted on One Island
news.body: Scientists counted about 180,000 Aldabra giant tortoises on Aldabra Atoll, a faraway island in the Indian Ocean that belongs to Seychelles. That's the most ever recorded for these gentle giants, which were once endangered and are now "thriving and stable." Aldabra is one of only two places in the world where giant tortoises live in the wild — the other is the Galápagos Islands.

news.headline: Sky Brown Skates to a Silver Medal
news.body: Skateboarding star Sky Brown, 18, won silver at the World Skate Games in Paraguay, just behind Japan's Mizuho Hasegawa, who took gold. Sky first skated in the Olympics when she was only 13! This result puts her on track to compete for Great Britain at the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles.
